feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Find the latest business news with reports on Wall Street, interest rates, banking, companies, and U.S. and world financial markets. Subscribe to the Business Story of the Day podcast.

entry.title: US diesel prices soar past $6 a gallon, deepening strain for hauling everyday goods
entry.summary: Diesel prices in the U.S. has hit yet another record, soaring past $6 a gallon on average as Washington's war with Iran disrupts the world's flow of fuel

entry.title: The U.S.-Canada trade war is creating a headache for auto-parts makers
entry.summary: For decades, the U.S. and Canadian auto supply chains have been tightly woven together. The trade war is threatening to unravel a complex system.

entry.title: From DOGE to space lasers, Alex Gibney peels back the many layers of Elon Musk
entry.summary: In the Oscar-winning filmmaker's latest documentary, director Alex Gibney investigates the rise of Elon Musk and says what's behind Musk's success are distressing truths.

entry.title: Fintech companies are applying to become banks. Here's what it takes to become one
entry.summary: Many financial technology companies are applying to become banks. The Indicator finds out what it takes to go through this process and what benefits come with a bank charter.

entry.title: Why gains by Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen could push gas prices even higher
entry.summary: A Houthi advance along Yemen's Red Sea coast could help push gas prices up even more as the Iran-backed group also launches attacks on Saudi Arabia's oil facilities.

entry.title: Elon Musk threatens to sue over Gibney documentary's "space lasers" claim
entry.summary: The tech billionaire's attorney has put documentarian Alex Gibney and his production company on legal notice, claiming the Oscar-winning director defamed Musk in his nearly four-hour documentary.

entry.title: Fold the phone: Apple's new CEO unveils a foldable iPhone
entry.summary: New Apple CEO John Ternus announces the iPhone Duo, which folds like a passport and is the most radical iPhone design update in nearly 20 years.

entry.title: A new Anthropic model seeks to test how AI could impact the U.S. economy
entry.summary: Will artificial intelligence nibble around the edges of the economy or upend it altogether? A new, interactive model from Anthropic lets people tests their assumptions.

entry.title: Chrystia Freeland negotiated with Trump. Now she's watching a trade war unfold
entry.summary: Chrystia Freeland understands the U.S.-Canada relationship from her time at the negotiating table. Here's what she sees now.

entry.title: Has the economy gone C-shaped?
entry.summary: A K means the rich and poor are pulling apart. A C supposedly means they're coming back together. We hear the case for both. Which letter you see may depend on what you choose to pay attention to.
